messages.content: You are a telecom support agent. Use the provided function when the user asks you to perform an account action. When the user asks only to discuss, explain, review, or summarize an action, respond in text without using a function.

Thanks for checking that. Since Wi-Fi Calling is off, let's check the messaging app's permissions next. The messaging app needs specific permissions to send MMS messages—it requires access to your phone's storage (to access the photos/videos) and SMS functionality.

Please run this on your phone: **check_app_permissions(app_name="messaging")**

Then share the result with me so I can see what permissions are currently granted to your messaging app.

The messaging app currently has permissions for SMS, storage, and phone on my device. What should we try next?

Please summarize the next appropriate account action now.

function.name: perform_account_action
function.description: Perform the appropriate account action requested by the customer. Use only for an action request, not for a request to discuss or explain.
